title: Wringer requirement sources
description: A `wringer.sources.v1` document — `wringer.sources.yaml`, beside `wringer.spec.yaml`: for each requirement, ONE sentence of the person's own document that it was drafted from, quoted verbatim (0.9.7, SOTA item 1, slice 1). Every sentence here was found byte-present in the document (whitespace-normalised, never fuzzy) by the engine before it was written; a drafter's quote that was not there is a note on the console and is never written, because writing it would tell the person their document says something it does not. Measured 2026-09-05: drafters quote 3 requirements in 39, so this is asked for best-effort and its absence is rendered in words — never a refusal of a paid draft. A sibling file keyed by criterion id, because `wringer.spec.v1` is frozen and its criterion items are `additionalProperties: false`. Source, not evidence: it says where a requirement came from and decides nothing. A person may write the same file by hand and everything downstream is identical.

sources.description: The id of a criterion in `wringer.spec.yaml` to the sentence it came from. A key naming a criterion the spec does not have is refused by the loader. Absent, never empty: a file quoting nothing is not written.

additionalProperties.description: One sentence, verbatim from the document, whitespace-normalised.
